description: Makes a new Data Studio dashboard in the workspace, saved as made by the assistant for the person, from a template (list_dashboard_templates gives the ids) or from a whole document you wrote. Send template or document, not both. The document is checked strictly and nothing is made if a panel is wrong; the answer then says what. The workspace's members see it in Data Studio at once. The answer gives the new dashboard's id and version.

document.description: In place of template: the whole first version. A dashboard document is { schemaVersion: 1, title, description, projects: "all" or [project ids], range: { kind: "last", amount, unit: hour|day|week|month } or { kind: "between", from, to }, filters: [{ dimension, op, values }], panels: [...] }. Each panel has a unique id, a title, layout { x, y, w, h } on a 12-column grid, filters (a list, may be empty) and its kind: number { metric, compare }, trend { metrics (1 to 3), grain }, bars { metric, dimension, limit }, table { metric, dimension, limit }, note { text }. Metric and dimension ids come from list_dashboard_metrics; read_dashboard shows a real document to copy from.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique text. Sending the same key again answers the dashboard the first call made and makes no second one, so a retry after a lost answer is safe.

template.description: A template's id, such as site-overview or blank.

title.description: With a template: the dashboard's name. Left out: the template's.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: create_dashboard
title: Make a new dashboard
